title: The Outsiders arrive and Hogan forms the nWo
summary: Scott Hall and Kevin Nash present themselves as outsiders threatening WCW. Their promised third man turns out to be the promotion’s biggest hero, transforming the invasion into the New World Order.

chapters.title: Hall declares war
chapters.result: Scott Hall interrupts Nitro and challenges WCW.
chapters.context: His arrival uses his recent WWE identity to create uncertainty, without making this an actual WWE-sponsored invasion.

chapters.title: Nash joins Hall
chapters.context: A second high-profile arrival makes the outsiders’ threat harder for WCW to dismiss.

chapters.title: Hogan is the third man
chapters.result: Hogan attacks Savage and joins Hall and Nash.
chapters.context: The leg drop turns WCW’s hero into the leader of its chief antagonist faction. The angle, rather than a clean match finish, is the milestone.

chapters.title: Hollywood Hogan takes the title
chapters.result: Hogan defeats the Giant for the world championship.
chapters.context: The nWo’s takeover gains the promotion’s leading belt, which the group marks with its own identity.
